dataset: Lonsdorf spring floral resource index, 0-1, per grid cell per year
source: USDA Cropland Data Layer (https://www.nass.usda.gov/Research_and_Science/Cropland/Release/datasets/{year}_30m_cdls.zip) scored with Koh et al. (2016) expert spring values
method: area-weighted mean of the Koh spring index over CDL classes within a foraging radius (exactextract, EPSG:5070); CDL class 0 (Background) treated as nodata, not as zero forage
retrieved: 2026-08-07/08 (northeast, conus); pa and ny inherited with the dissertation

validation.national vs per-state CDL: r = 0.9995, mean absolute difference 0.0001 over 221,155 cell-years; national is more complete (no state-border gaps)

known_gaps: pennsylvania 2017 is short 1,452 of 7,452 cells (a CDL gap); ForageGrid.get falls back to the nearest year for the same cell and records every substitution in ForageGrid.fallbacks
rebuild_cost: ~1.9 GB CDL download per year, plus zonal statistics; per-year partials in {region}_forage_by_year/ so a rebuild only redoes what is missing
